title: feat(c3f0): report cov3(f0)=212 for mixed3-silent cov2-maximizer
science: Three-site coverage of the mixed3-silent cov2=66 map f0=(1,1,1,1,0): cov3(f0)=212 of 220, with 8 unfilled. Contrast recorded in the same note: cov3(f_L1)=220 and cov3(f1)=(1,1,1,1,1)=220, both perfect. So the mixed3 bit that was free at |S|<=2 costs f0 exactly 8 three-site seeds - a quantified price for silencing mixed3, and a third confirmation that mixed3 first bites at |S|=3 (#6437). Single-map
